## Type of change

- [ ] feat — new functionality
- [ ] fix — bug fix
- [ ] docs / test / refactor / build / ci / chore

## Checklist

- [ ] PR title is a valid [Conventional Commit](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/)
- [ ] `make check` passes locally (lint, vuln, tests, coverage gate)
- [ ] New/changed code is covered by tests (unit; integration if it touches real sockets/processes)
- [ ] Docs updated (`docs/`, command help, README) for user-facing changes
- [ ] Golden files regenerated with `-update` and reviewed, if output changed
- [ ] `TASKS.md` updated if this completes or changes a roadmap task
